in_sanskrit.name: Bandhul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Bond, Connection
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bandhul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Bandhul is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘bandhana’ which means ‘to bind’ or ‘connection’. It symbolizes the strong bond between individuals, especially in relationships and family. This name is believed to bring unity and harmony.
